summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests CD83 CAR T cells, which are genetically engineered immune cells, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Patients get leukapheresis to collect cells, then fludarabine and cyclophosphamide IV on days -5 to -3, then CD83 CAR T cells IV over 15 minutes on day 0. The study looks at safety, side effects, and the best dose, and the record does not list a separate primary outcome measure.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa células CAR T con CD83, que son células inmunitarias modificadas genéticamente, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. Los pacientes se someten primero a leucaféresis para obtener las células, luego reciben fludarabina y ciclofosfamida por vía intravenosa en los días -5 a -3, y después células CAR T con CD83 por vía intravenosa durante 15 minutos el día 0. El estudio analiza la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, y el registro no enumera una medida de resultado principal por separado.
who_for: Karnofsky performance status of 70% or higher.
Relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia as defined in the record.
At least 15% of AML blasts express CD83 by flow cytometry.
Meets stated kidney, liver, heart, lung and blood count limits.
not_for: Active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Other active cancer within 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Ongoing uncontrolled serious infection, HIV, or active hepatitis B or C.
